summary: Haraka is an asynchronous mail transfer agent built to process incoming and outgoing email at high volume. Written in JavaScript, it uses an event-driven architecture to handle network traffic efficiently without spawning heavy worker processes for every connection.
goodFor: It is suited for administrators looking to build custom email routing logic or security filters using JavaScript plugins rather than traditional configuration languages.
watchOut: Node-based mail servers demand careful monitoring of event loop blockages and memory limits under sustained high traffic loads, and they have a smaller community footprint than established alternatives like Postfix or Exim.
deployNotes: Because it runs on Node.js, you will need a modern runtime environment installed on your server along with process managers like PM2 to keep the service running reliably in the background.
